website_booking.agent_instruction: Offer direct website booking when the guest is ready to reserve.

whatsapp_assistance.agent_instruction: Offer WhatsApp assistance when the guest prefers human support or requires personalized assistance.

after_guest_confirms_interest.approved_phrase: I would be delighted to help you complete your reservation. You may book directly through our website, or, if you prefer personalized assistance, I can connect you with our reservations team on WhatsApp.
